description:
Ask the CoreModels team for a scoping call: the escalation path when this MCP server cannot do the
job alone (a plan limit, a missing capability, or a question only a person can answer). Call it when
you are stuck for that reason, not as a first resort.

Creates a sales lead; a person from the CoreModels team follows up by email. No project id and no
sign-in needed: this is the one tool on /mcp that works without a JWT. Rate-limited per caller and
in total. The person named in contact_email must have agreed to be contacted (consent: true).

calling_agent_name.description: Name of the AI agent or application making this call (self-reported, e.g. 'Claude Desktop', 'Cursor', a custom script name).

consent.description: Must be true: confirms the person named in contact_name/contact_email has agreed to be contacted by email.

contact_email.description: Email of the person who should be contacted. They are told why: a person replies within one business day.

contact_name.description: Name of the person who should be contacted.

need.description: What help is needed, in your own words — the plan limit, missing capability, or question that brought you here.

recent_tool_calls.description: Names of the MCP tools you called before this one, in order, for context on what led here.

name: contact_sales
title: Contact Sales
